# Healthcare Governance

This folder contains the central governance and advisory bodies responsible for overseeing clinical quality development and database management within the Danish acute surgery healthcare system. It includes the steering groups and quality committees that evaluate clinical indicators, approve methodological changes, and drive quality improvement initiatives for the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB). Together, these organizations balance clinical evidence with administrative requirements to standardize treatment and data registration practices across Danish regions.

## Pages

- [[lkt-akut-kirurgi|LKT Akutkirurgi]] — The Learning and Quality Team for acute surgery that drove national quality improvements and indicator alignment before concluding its primary phase in 2022.
- [[lkt|LKT]] — The Danish Medical Association's Quality Committee, which advises on and supports the registration of clinical quality indicators such as post-operative nutrition.
- [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] — The central decision-making steering group under RKKP that governs the acute surgery database, approving indicator modifications and resolving data registration challenges.
